race.comment: SMOOTH CHINO (4) on top in The Meteorite. There wasn't much between he and MAZU (2) when they clashed in the G2 Mcewen Stakes at Flemington but the margin undersold SMOOTH CHINO's victory, knuckling down late off a moderate speed to run MAZU down, which he gets every chance to do so again. MAZU has since run awfully in the G1 Champions Sprint when playing up badly pre-race. He's much better than that and should find the front around here. NDOLA (5) is flying. He was awesome winning the Apache Cat Classic here then too strong again at Flemington. He'll be very hard to hold out. MERIDIUS (9) was excellent first up behind NDOLA but will need a lot of luck from the inside gate. CHARM STONE (6) is going okay and certainly up to this at her best.
